candidates.title: City station readings (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 (µg/m³) from the city's own monitoring stations. Covers production window (2024-01-01 onward). Station coordinates are needed for spatial join with traffic data. Has a known wiki issue: station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off on 2024-06-30 — readings stop there.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('Valdena air quality station hourly readings')
suspected_issues: Station VR-03 was switched off 2024-06-30; no readings after that date
Temporal coverage starts 2023-01-01, so does NOT cover prototype window (2004-2005)
No temperature/humidity columns in schema — weather need (N3) must be sourced elsewhere even for production
Access requires request to Environment Monitoring Unit — not yet confirmed as granted

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly vehicle counts from road counters near monitoring stations. Covers production window from 2021 onward. Needed to model traffic contribution to air pollution.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('traffic sensor hourly counts vehicle flow 2024 2025')
suspected_issues: Counter replacement on 2024-03-18 changed direction recording (per-direction before, combined after) — cannot compare counts across the break without adjustment
Catalog entry has no note about this change per wiki page 'counter_replacement_2024'
No sensor location metadata in catalog — needs separate asset register to match spatially to air quality stations
Access requires request to Mobility Office

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily respiratory clinic visit counts by district of residence, no patient identifiers. Covers production window from 2022 onward. Explicitly approved by Data Protection Office for this surveillance purpose.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('respiratory clinic visits daily by district counts')
suspected_issues: Weekends and public holidays likely have zero visits — pattern must be distinguished from missing data
Diagnosis classification system not documented (ICD-10 vs local coding)
District boundaries may have changed during 2024-2025

candidates.title: Clinic visits (one row per patient visit)
candidates.why_relevant: Patient-level visit records with age band, postcode and diagnosis code. Could theoretically serve N5 at event grain.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('Valdena clinic patient visit records respiratory')
suspected_issues: Data Protection Office explicitly prohibits use: 'Patient-level visit records (clinic.patient_visits) may not be used for this analysis' per wiki page 'clinic_data_policy'
Contains PII (patient_key, age_band, postcode) — cannot leave clinic systems
Access requires Data Protection Office approval which policy says will not be granted for this use case

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly ERA5 reanalysis data (temperature_2m, relative_humidity_2m) covering both windows. Registered and approved for prototyping AND production. Must set coordinates to a northern Italian city (default is Lisbon).
suspected_issues: Default coordinates are Lisbon (38.72, -9.14) — must be changed to northern Italy (e.g. Milan ~45.46, 9.19 or similar justified location)
ERA5 reanalysis ~9-31 km resolution may miss local microclimatic effects
Historical data may have 5-30 day latency
No internal weather station data found for validation

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Italian public holidays for 2024-2025 needed to model zero-visit days in clinic data (weekends and holidays). Registered and approved.
suspected_issues: Only provides holiday dates — does not directly satisfy a need
Useful ancillary data for N4 modelling

candidates.title: AtmosData Pro station-grade weather feed
candidates.why_relevant: Station-grade weather data that could have covered N3 for production window at higher local accuracy than Open-Meteo reanalysis.
suspected_issues: Agreement expired 2025-12-31 and renewal not signed
API key revoked 2026-01-01
No approved purposes listed — not usable for either window
Included for transparency: rejected source
